notes.text: Codification Section, Pub. L. 107–331, title VI, § 602, Dec. 13, 2002, 116 Stat. 2845, which set out congressional findings, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.

Short TitlePub. L. 107–331, title VI, § 601, Dec. 13, 2002, 116 Stat. 2845, provided that title VI of Pub. L. 107–331, enacting this subchapter, could be cited as the “Cherokee, Choctaw, and Chickasaw Nations Claims Settlement Act”.

ancestors.heading: CHEROKEE, CHOCTAW, AND CHICKASAW NATIONS CLAIMS SETTLEMENT
